name: Dataslayer mcp
description:
Analyze your marketing, analytics, ecommerce, and SEO data directly in Claude using natural language. Connect to leading platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics 4, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Microsoft Ads, Shopify, HubSpot, Google Search Console and more.

Retrieve up-to-date metrics, combine data from multiple sources and turn complex datasets into clear insights without writing SQL or code. Ask questions as you would ask a colleague, compare campaign performance, identify trends and generate reports to make faster, data-driven decisions.

With Dataslayer MCP, your marketing data becomes part of the conversation, making it easier to explore performance, uncover opportunities and automate recurring analysis directly in Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Dataslayer mcp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Dataslayer mcp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://agents.dataslayer.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Dataslayer mcp MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dataslayer mcp provides these MCP tools: check_task_id, dataslayer_subscription_information, get_available_connections_and_accounts_info_by_datasource, get_available_datasources, get_available_fields_by_datasource, get_schedules_from_user, manage_alerts, manage_data_transfer_schedules, and natural_to_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Dataslayer mcp?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Dataslayer mcp in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Dataslayer mcp MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dataslayer mcp requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Dataslayer mcp is developed by Dataslayer.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
